summary: Scanned the in-scope package files for git:github.com/ghoseb/pi-askuserquestion using the package-vetter rubric. The package path was valid, README.md and the package-referenced src/index.ts were scanned, and one R-07 warning was found because the registered tool description contains imperative instructions directed at the LLM.

retrospective.workedWell: The scoped package files were easy to locate from package.json, and the output schema allowed the package-vetter verdict fields to coexist with the minih retrospective fields.
retrospective.confusing: briefing.md was not copied into the run directory even though the prompt said to read it from the agent pack's directory; I had to locate the source copy under agents/package-vetter/briefing.md. The optimized write tool was blocked by the read-only preset even though the task required creating output/report.json.
retrospective.magicWand: Copy briefing.md into each package-vetter run directory, or expose an explicit MINIH_BRIEFING_PATH environment variable so agents can read the exact rubric without searching.

coordination.notes: No coordination channel was available or needed for this one-shot scan.

difficulties.description: The prompt instructed the agent to read briefing.md in the agent pack's directory, but the run directory did not contain briefing.md.
difficulties.workaround: Searched the repository for the agent pack rubric and used /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/pij/agents/package-vetter/briefing.md.

difficulties.description: The apply_patch write path was denied by the read-only run preset even though the runner required writing output/report.json.
difficulties.workaround: Used the allowed shell command path to write the required JSON artifact.
